annual.debt_basis: total tag (LongTermDebt, long-term incl. current maturities; no short-term borrowings filed)

ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: sum of the four quarterly DPS facts 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.frequency_basis: spacing of the latest 4 positive quarterly DPS facts (2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30); the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

share_issuance.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

dividends.price_note: price: neither prices.json nor score.json carries a price — yields null
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

legs.share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters
not filed for any of the four quarters

dividend_yield.basis: sum of the four quarterly DPS facts 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

net_buyback_yield.note: share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters

shareholder_yield.label: —

notes: buybacks: quarters left out (not a sign error) — quarter ended 2023-12-31: the year-to-date facts decrease (2023-01-01..2023-09-30 = 203,700,000 > 2023-01-01..2023-12-31 = 203,500,000) — no quarter can be derived from them (the quarterly row read -200,000; typically a line tagged in one filing and not in the next); left out (a missing quarter)
annual_dps: FY2018, FY2019, FY2020 = sum of the four filed quarterly DPS facts (no FY fact)

dps_cagr_5y: null — the 5-year window FY2020→FY2025 has no annual DPS between FY2020 (period ended 2020-12-31) and FY2023 (period ended 2023-12-31) — a dividend suspension or unfiled years, not a growth path
share_issuance_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed share_issuance figure (missing 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30)
